note: Regression set for the Tender Agent scorer (brief §2). Three true positives and three near-misses the filter must reject. The rejections do more work than the positives — the failure mode is a cultural-looking buyer running a research or consultation brief. Phase 2 runs this on every prompt change; if any of the six flips, the change does not ship.

cases.title: Venice Biennale PR Consultant
cases.summary: International arts earned media on the UK Pavilion.
expected_reasons: buyer is a national arts/cultural body
scope is international earned media / PR for an arts commission

cases.title: Media Relations and PR Services
cases.summary: Global media relations for a national destination organisation.
expected_reasons: buyer is a national destination/tourism body
scope is global media relations / PR

cases.title: Global Strategic Communications and Media
cases.summary: International press office for a national destination body.
expected_reasons: buyer is a national destination body
scope is an international press office / strategic communications

cases.title: Audience Research
cases.summary: Right buyer, wrong service — market research needing MRS accreditation, not PR.
disqualifiers: service is market/audience research, not earned media/PR

cases.title: Consultation Consultant
cases.summary: Heritage project tagged with a PR CPV code, but the scope is community consultation.
disqualifiers: scope is community consultation, not media relations/PR

cases.title: Design Agency Services
disqualifiers: buyer is not an arts/culture/design/heritage/destination body
scope is design agency services, not cultural PR
